brand.name: Itqan
upload.hud: Send me what you have and I will go read it.
upload.title: Add your documents
upload.recommend: PDF gives the most accurate reading. Clear photos also work.
upload.privacy: Your document stays private to your account. You will review everything Itqan reads before anything else happens.
upload.noDoc: I do not have my documents right now
upload.noDocHint: Enter your details by hand and add the documents later.
upload.errType: That file type cannot be read. Use a PDF, an image, or a Word document.
upload.errSize: That file is over 10 MB. Try a smaller scan or export it as a PDF.
upload.errEmpty: That file appears to be empty. Choose another copy of it.
questions.hud: Reading your documents now. A few questions while I do.
progress.awaitingYou: Your details are ready to check
progress.matching: Matching you to roles and courses
dash.readinessNoGoal: This measures you against entry level roles broadly. Tell Itqan the job you want and it will measure you against that one instead.
dash.yourSkillsSub: What your documents evidence, and how strongly.
dash.skillsLabel: Your skills, and how well your documents evidence each one
dash.noGaps: No gaps to close right now.
dash.goalChange: Change the role you are working towards
dash.goalFindingHelp: Ask Hud and he will suggest roles from what he read.
dash.goalBlankHint: Leave this empty if you are not sure yet.
questions.waiting: Still reading. You can continue when it finishes.
questions.failed: Itqan could not read that document.
questions.failedHelp: Your answers here are saved. You can upload a different file or fill in your details by hand.
confirm.title: Check what Itqan read
confirm.skillsEmpty: No skills yet. Add the ones you have.
confirm.sub: Itqan read your documents. Correct anything wrong before it is used. Nothing moves forward until you confirm.
confirm.lowConfidenceHelp: Itqan is not certain about this one. Please check it.
confirm.name: Your name
confirm.namePlaceholder: As it appears on your certificate
confirm.birthNotRead: Not read from your document. Add it if you would like. It is optional.
confirm.gradYearOnly: Your document says {year} but not which month. Please pick the month.
confirm.skillsFoundSub: Itqan matched these to courses in your documents and is confident about them.
confirm.skillsUnsureSub: Itqan saw something that points to these but could not tie it to one course. That does not mean they are wrong. Keep the ones that are yours.
confirm.skillFromUnknown: No single course to point to
confirm.skillsRemovedBefore: Your new document also mentions these, which you removed before. Add any you want back.
confirm.addSkillPlaceholder: Type a skill and press enter
confirm.consent: I confirm these details are correct, and Itqan may use them to find matches for me.
confirm.errName: Add your name so matches can be addressed to you.
confirm.errBirthFuture: That date is in the future. Check the year.
confirm.errBirthRange: Check that year. It looks outside a usual range.
confirm.errBirthTooYoung: You need to be at least {min} to use Itqan.
confirm.birthHint: Day, month and year you were born.
confirm.errGradRange: Check that date. It looks outside a usual range.
confirm.errConsent: Confirm the details are correct to continue.
confirm.errSkills: Add at least one skill, or go back and upload something.
confirm.emptySub: Fill these in and Itqan works from them.
confirm.partialSub: The items marked below need your eye before Itqan uses them.
dash.readinessHowBody: This is how much of what the role you want actually asks for is already evidenced in your documents. It moves as you add documents and finish courses. It is a guide, not a score anyone else sees.
dash.matches: Job postings you qualify for now
dash.gapsSub: Adding these opens more of the roles you are aiming at.
dash.nextCourse: The next course on your path, from {provider}. It opens {skills}.
dash.nextCoursePlain: The next course on your path, from {provider}.
dash.pathClearBody: You have marked every course here as done. Upload your updated CV so those skills count as evidence rather than as your word for it.
dash.emptyMatchesSub: Itqan needs a little more to work from. Adding another document usually helps.
jobs.title: Job postings
jobs.empty: No job postings to show here yet
jobs.emptySub: Try another filter, or add a document so Itqan has more to match against.
courses.title: Courses
courses.emptySub: Name the role you are aiming for and the courses that close the distance appear here.
state.workingTitle: Your results are on the way
state.workingSub: The matching is still running. This page fills in on its own, so there is no need to reload.
state.errorSub: This is usually temporary. Try again in a moment.
rate.title: How is Itqan working out for you?
rate.lead: One rating, and a comment only if you feel like it. It takes a moment and it is the fastest way to tell us what to fix.
rate.pick: Choose a rating to send one.
rate.commentLabel: Anything you want to add? Optional.
rate.commentPlaceholder: What worked, or what got in your way
rate.failed: That rating did not send. Nothing was lost, and you can try again.
resume.title: Pick up where you left off
resume.body: You were part way through. Everything you entered was kept.
doc.transcriptHint: Adds the coursework behind your skills.
doc.cvHint: Adds experience a transcript cannot show.
doc.certificateHint: Confirms your award and its date.
doc.certificationHint: Courses and licences earned outside your degree.
doc.recommendationHint: Adds context an employer will read.
doc.otherHint: Anything else you think is relevant.
upload.missingRequired: Add your CV to continue. It is the one document Itqan cannot read your background without. A transcript is welcome too, and adds evidence.
upload.othersLater: You can add your transcript later. It is optional, and it lets Itqan corroborate what your CV claims.
browse.nothingNew: Nothing new since the last check.
upload.kindLabel: What kind of document is this?
journey.title: Your journey
journey.complete: Every stage is done. Keep adding documents as you earn them.
q.coursePricing.title: Are paid courses okay?
q.coursePricing.optHelp.any: Paid courses appear with the price shown up front.
q.workArrangement.title: Where would you like to work?
q.workArrangement.help: Jobs like this come first. You will still see the others.
q.knowsRole.title: Do you know what job you want?
q.knowsRole.help: Either answer is fine. Not knowing is where most people start.
q.knowsRole.optHelp.yes: You will be asked which one.
q.knowsRole.optHelp.no: Hud will suggest roles from what your documents show.
chat.welcomeRoles: Welcome. Itqan has read your documents and found roles you could aim for. Here they are, with what is behind each one.
q.preferredRole.title: What kind of job are you looking for?
q.preferredRole.label: The job you have in mind
q.preferredRole.placeholder: For example: data analyst, or something with numbers
q.openToOtherRoles.title: Want to see similar jobs too?
q.openToOtherRoles.help: Your studies often fit jobs you have not heard of.
q.openToOtherRoles.optHelp.yes: Related jobs appear next to the ones you asked for.
q.openToOtherRoles.optHelp.no: Only jobs near the one you named.
documents.title: Your documents
documents.sub: Replace your documents and Itqan will read them again. Your gap, courses and job matches update with what it finds.
documents.privacy: Your documents stay private to your account. You will review everything Itqan reads before anything changes.
documents.reviewNote: Nothing changes until you confirm what Itqan read.
documents.failedHelp: The documents were uploaded. Try reading them again in a moment.
documents.cvRequired: Itqan needs a CV to read. Add one, then try again.
documents.limitReached: You have used today's tokens. Your profile page shows when they come back.
documents.limitTokens: Re-reading your documents costs {needed} tokens and you have {remaining} left today. They come back tomorrow.
profile.title: Your profile
profile.skillsFromDocs: Itqan read these from your documents. Correct one it misread, or add one it missed.
profile.incompleteHelp: Filling these in gives Itqan more to match you on.
profile.empty: Add your CV and Itqan builds your profile from it.
profile.phoneHint: Optional. Itqan never calls you and never shares this.
profile.photoHint: A square image works best. Up to 5MB.
profile.photoTooBig: That image is over 5MB. Try a smaller one.
profile.photoWrongType: That file is not an image. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP.
profile.photoFailed: The photo could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
profile.suggestedRoleNone: Nothing suggested yet. Itqan suggests a role once it has read your documents.
fb.whyHelp: This shapes what you are shown next. You can skip it.
fb.thanks: Noted. Your next suggestions will use this.
fb.replaced: Replaced with another course that closes the same gap.
fb.noSimilar: Nothing else closes this gap right now. Your dislike was saved.
fb.cost: This costs {cost} tokens, and you have {remaining} left today.
fb.cannotAfford: Finding another costs {cost} tokens and you have {remaining} left today. Your tokens reset tomorrow.
fb.findFailed: That search did not come back. Nothing was spent, and you can try again.
fb.noOtherJob: Nothing else on your list fits better right now. Your feedback was saved.
fb.replacedJob: Replaced with another posting matched to you.
chat.newHint: Start a new conversation with Hud
chat.title: Hud
chat.rerun.offer.full: Read my documents again and re-match
chat.rerun.cost: This costs {cost} tokens, and you have {remaining} left today.
chat.rerun.cannotAfford: This costs {cost} tokens and you have {remaining} left today. Your tokens reset tomorrow.
chat.rerun.started: Re-running your matching. You can carry on, and the results update themselves.
chat.open.roles: I do not know what job I want
chat.open.skills: I need help with my skills
chat.open.courses: Which course should I take next?
chat.failed: That did not come back. Nothing you asked has been lost.
chat.tooBig: {name} is over 5MB. Pick a smaller file.
chat.disclaimer: Hud is AI and can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.
journey.buildingBody: Start with the first course below. Job matches show up here once your skills cover enough of what these roles are asking for.
dash.lowMatchesTitle: Not yet, and that is fine
dash.lowMatchesBody: There is nothing here worth your time applying to today. The courses below are ordered so the first one moves you furthest.
courses.doneNoted: Marked as done, and the skills it teaches are now on your profile.
update.title: Your journey is a step behind
update.scope.documents: Your documents changed, so Itqan needs to read them again before your skills, courses and job matches can catch up.
update.scope.skills: Your skills changed. Itqan can rebuild your courses and job matches from them without re-reading your documents.
update.cost: This costs {cost} tokens, and you have {remaining} left today.
update.cannotAfford: This costs {cost} tokens and you have {remaining} left today, so it cannot run yet. Your tokens reset tomorrow.
update.failed: That could not be started just now. Nothing has changed, and you can try again.
update.docsItemRead: Itqan reads your documents again, from the files you have now.
update.docsItemSkills: Your skills are rebuilt from what it reads, and you check them before anything else changes.
update.docsItemRest: Your readiness, your course path and your job matches follow from there.
update.skillsItemFrom: Itqan starts from the skills you have now. Your documents are not read again, and you are not asked to confirm an extraction you did not change.
update.skillsItemRest: Your readiness, your course path and your job matches are rebuilt from them.
update.skillsItemKeep: Everything you have marked as done stays done.
skills.editNote: Correcting your skills changes what Itqan matches you against, so it will offer to rebuild your courses and job matches afterwards.
courses.doneSkills: You finished {title}, and {skills} are now on your profile. Rebuild your courses and job matches from them?
courses.doneNoSkills: You finished {title}. Rebuild your courses and job matches?
dash.celebrate: Your readiness went up by {n}. That came from work you did.
courses.mapHint: Use the arrows to move along the path, or drag the map. Open any course to see everything about it.
profile.docsCvRequired: Your CV is the one document Itqan cannot work without, so there is only ever one: replace it rather than adding another.
docs.replacedNoRead: Saved. Itqan has not read the new file yet, so your skills and matches are unchanged until you ask for a re-read.
docs.replaceFailed: That file could not be saved. The document you had is unchanged, and you can try again.
docs.kindFailed: That category could not be saved. The document is unchanged, and you can try again.
docs.cvTaken: You already have a CV, and there is only ever one. Replace it instead of making this one your CV.
docs.rereadNote: Reading your documents again is a separate step, and it ends with you checking what Itqan read before anything changes.
profile.aiPrices: A message costs {message} · re-reading your documents costs {reread}
profile.aiUsageUnavailable: Your usage is not available right now.
profile.doc.lastCv: This is your only CV, and Itqan cannot match you without one. Upload a newer CV first, then remove this one.
profile.doc.removeFailed: That document could not be removed just now. It is still in your list.
jobs.lowTitle: Not yet, and that is fine
jobs.lowBody: Nothing on this list is worth your time applying to today. The courses on your path are ordered so the first one moves you furthest towards being able to.
jobs.lowShown: These are shown at your request. Your readiness is still low for them, so treat a rejection as information about timing rather than about you.
courses.undoneNoted: Put back on your path. Nothing else changed.
notice.transcriptUnreadable: Your transcript could not be read, so this is based on your CV alone. You can upload it again from your documents.
notice.transcriptExtractionFailed: Something went wrong reading your transcript, so this is based on your CV alone. Trying again usually works.
notice.someFilesUnreadable: Some of your files could not be opened and were skipped.
notice.cvUnreadable: We could not read any text from your CV.
notice.cvExtractionFailed: Something went wrong reading your CV.
notice.courseworkNotResearched: We could not look up what your courses teach, so fewer skills may appear.
notice.courseworkNotDerived: We could not work out the skills your coursework covers, so fewer skills may appear.
documents.duplicateKind: Two of these are the same kind of document. Both will be read together. Remove one if it is not part of the same document.
jobs.lockedBody: Your three strongest matches are free and stay that way. Premium opens the rest of the list, so you can work through every opening you actually fit rather than the top of it.
plan.title: Your plan
plan.rowCore: Where you stand, your path, the advisor
plan.cancelNote: Cancel any time. You keep Premium until the month you have paid for runs out.
plan.confirming: Payment received. Waiting for it to reach your account, which can take a moment.
plan.failed: That did not go through and you have not been charged. You can try again.
plan.onPaid: You are on Premium. Every job you fit is on your job postings page.
settings.title: Settings
settings.supportBody: Write or call and a person answers. The privacy policy and the terms of use are below.
settings.deactivateBody: Everything is kept. Itqan stops working on it and stops matching you to anything until you log back in.
settings.deactivateItemKept: Your documents, your profile, your course path and your job matches are kept.
settings.deactivateItemStops: Itqan stops reading them, stops refreshing your matches, and stops matching you to anything.
settings.deactivateItemBack: You are signed out. Logging back in turns the account on again.
settings.deactivateReversible: Nothing is deleted, and you can undo this yourself at any time.
settings.deleteBody: Your documents and everything Itqan read from them are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteItemDocs: Every document you uploaded, including your CV.
settings.deleteItemProfile: Your profile, and every skill Itqan read from those documents.
settings.deleteItemMatches: Your job matches, your readiness and your course path.
settings.deleteItemAccount: The account itself, and the email address it signs in with.
settings.deleteIrreversible: This cannot be undone, and nothing here can be brought back afterwards.
settings.closeFailed: That did not go through. Your account is unchanged, and you can try again.
plan.card: To change the card you pay with, use the receipt emailed to you.
plan.cancelItemUntil: Premium stays on until {date}. Nothing changes before then.
plan.cancelItemUntilNoDate: Premium stays on until the month you have paid for runs out. Nothing changes before then.
plan.cancelItemAfter: After that your account goes back to Free: your three strongest job matches, and the smaller daily budget.
plan.cancelComeBack: You can subscribe again whenever you want, and nothing you have built is lost in between.
plan.cancelFailed: That could not be started just now. Your subscription is unchanged, and you can try again.
plan.alreadyCancelled: Your subscription is already cancelled. Premium runs until {date}, and you are not charged again.
plan.alreadyCancelledNoDate: Your subscription is already cancelled. Premium runs until the month you have paid for runs out, and you are not charged again.
settings.deleteBlockedBody: Cancel your subscription first. Deleting your account does not stop the billing, so Itqan asks you to end it yourself rather than leave you paying for an account that is gone.
settings.deleteItemSubscription: Your Premium runs until {date}. Deleting now ends it before that.
courses.saveFailed: That did not save. Your progress is unchanged, and you can try again.
err.network: We could not reach Itqan. Check your connection and try again.
err.refused: That did not go through. Nothing has changed.
err.session: You have been signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
err.credentials: That email and password do not match.
err.emailTaken: There is already an account with that email.
err.consentRequired: Confirm the details are correct to continue.
err.cvRequired: Add your CV first. It is the one document we cannot work without.
err.lastCv: This is your only CV. Upload a replacement first, then remove this one.
err.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check it and enter it again.
err.codeExpired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
err.invalidInput: Something in that is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
err.unreadable: We could not read that document. Try a clearer scan or a PDF.
err.confirmationRequired: Confirm what we read before this can continue.
err.noProfile: There is no profile yet. Add your documents and we will build one.
err.tokenLimit: You have used today's tokens. They reset tomorrow.
err.tokenLimitDetail: That costs {needed} tokens and you have {remaining} left today. They reset tomorrow.
